sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Link previews on MusicBrainz: the "[info]" link MusicBrainz writes after every URL of a relationship list or an event's "URLs" table has a card of its own (with "Preview linked entities on hover" on). It shows the URL's site and address and which entities link it, by relationship ("Setlistfm: Event: 2025‐05‐20: Co‐op Live, …"), naming three per relationship; Space pins it into a window that lists up to 100 per relationship and then links MusicBrainz's own page for the URL. While it loads, the card is named after the URL, not "info".

External link previews: on MusicBrainz an external link's window (Space, or a tap) now says what MusicBrainz knows of the URL — which entities link it, by relationship, with a link to MusicBrainz's page for the URL — or "Not in MusicBrainz", which on an annotation link adds that it is only in the annotation. One request to MusicBrainz, made by the window only and never by a hover, through the same one-a-second turn as the MusicBrainz cards; by the "[info]" link's MBID when the link has one (so the "[info]" card and the window share one answer), else by the link exactly as the page writes it. Shown whatever the site answered, so a dead link's window still says which entities point at it. "Not in MusicBrainz" is remembered until the page is reloaded only.

sections.label: 🔧 Refactor
items: Popup engine (org/iframe.org, "* generalize to URLs", U2): a url kind in _MB_KINDS and _MB_POP_PATH_RE, one lookup with every relationship include and nothing else (_MB_POP_URL_INC: a url lookup answers 400 to annotation, tags, genres, aliases and ratings, U0 X7); _mbPopUrlRelRows() groups a URL's relations by type, direction and entity kind. A url lookup keys a release group target "release_group", like its target type, while its page is /release-group/: _mbPopRelKind() gives the page segment, _mbPopRelEntity() the entity (both spellings), and _mbPopRelTargetHtml() takes the entity as an optional third argument. An _MB_KINDS entry may name its loading card with nameOf(a) (the "[info]" link: _mbPopUrlNameOf()). _extMbQuery()/_extMbLoad()/_extMbSectionHtml() add the external window's section: by the MBID of the "[info]" link right after the link (_extInfoMbid(), never past another link or a line break), else ?resource= with the href attribute verbatim; a 404 becomes {notFound: true}, kept in memory only. _MB_POP_PAGE_VERSION is 2: _mbParseEditPage() reads _MB_POP_PATH_RE, so an edit's entities now include URLs.

sections.label: 📝 Docs
items: tests/fixtures/popup-ext.spec.js: a "MusicBrainz URL entities (U2)" block (6 tests: the "[info]" card and window, release groups, the caps, the external window's section by MBID and by ?resource=, "not in MusicBrainz" kept for the page load only, the shared MusicBrainz gate) and the "[info]" link now resolving to the url kind; popup-ext.mobile.spec.js: a tap on "[info]" opens the URL's window, and the external window's tap shows the new section. scripts/capture-ws2-fixtures.py captures four URL lookups (ws2-pop-url-*.json); scripts/mutations/popup-ext.json gains 13 U2 mutations. tests/live/popup-ext.spec.js gains an @extended test on the event page of the request. HELP, docs/claude/detail-pages.md (new section "MusicBrainz URL entities"), CLAUDE.md's doc map, org/iframe.org, the two settings' descriptions.
